name: Crazy Shit
description: The album where the language gets loose: breaks fed through a shredder, a choir that thinks it is a microwave, a soprano who can only say meow, sines bent into their own harmonics, melodies grown by rewriting rules, the world's fastest polka, five tempos colliding, a swarm of bees inside your skull, a piano melted four different ways and a toaster with opinions. Nothing here is tasteful. Every sketch explains its trick in the comments.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Gremlin Factory
sketches.description: One drum break, scrambled, ratcheted, hurried and bit-crushed differently almost every bar, over a bass ring-modulated into a gargling metal lump and bells that never know their key.

sketches.name: Microwave Choir
sketches.description: A church choir that thinks it is a kitchen appliance: ring-modulated, frequency-shifted and humming like a turntable, while a robot sings beep boop and the timer dings three times.
sketches.source:
setcpm(70/4)

// A choir ring-modulated at 220 Hz, its partials sliding back and forth by a few hertz
choir: note("<[c3,e3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3] [f2,a2,c3] [g2,b2,d3]>").s("choir")
  .syl("<ah oo ee oh>").ringmod(220).ringmix(.4).fshift(sine.range(-60, 60).slow(8))
  .attack(1).release(2).space("church").gain(.3)

// A robot tenor: the spectral robot effect flattens every partial onto one pitch
robot: note("<c4 ab3 a3 b3>").s("voice").syl("<beep boop bip bop>").voicetype("tenor")
  .spectral("robot").samount(.8).mono(1).vglide(.05).gain(.28)

// The turntable hum, and the timer: three dings at the end of every eight bars
hum: s("engine").slow(8).lpf(300).gain(.12)
ding: note("<~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [c6 c6 c6 ~]>").s("sine").fm(3).fmh(3.5)
  .decay(1.2).sustain(0).release(1).room(.4).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Cat Opera
sketches.description: A soprano who can only say meow, gliding three vowels across every note with a dramatic scoop, a tenor tomcat answering from the fence, pizzicato strings in a violin body and a purr underneath.
sketches.source:
setcpm(66/4)

// The diva: mi_a_u glides across three vowels in one note, scooping up into each
diva: note("<[g4@3 c5] [e5@2 d5 c5] [a5@4] [g5@2 ~@2]>")
  .s("voice").syl("mi_a_u").voicetype("soprano").scoop(-7).jitter(.5)
  .mono(1).vglide(.15).attack(.1).release(.8).space("hall").gain(.3)

// The tomcat answers from the fence, gravelly, off to the left
tom: note("<~ [c3@2 g2@2] ~ [eb3@3 c3]>").s("voice").syl("ma_o").voicetype("tenor").fry(.6)
  .mono(2).vglide(.2).release(.6).azimuth(-60).distance(3).gain(.26)

// The orchestra plucks along inside a violin body
pizz: note("<[c3 e3 g3 e3] [f3 a3 c4 a3] [d3 f3 a3 f3] [g3 b3 d4 b3]>").s("triangle").timbre("bright")
  .decay(.15).sustain(0).body("violin").bodymix(.3).room(.4).gain(.2)

// The purr: a low saw trembling twenty-five times a second
purr: note("c1").slow(4).s("sawtooth").lpf(200).trem(25).tremdepth(.8)
  .attack(1).sustain(1).release(1).gain(.12)

sketches.name: Chebyshev's Revenge
sketches.description: A plain sine pushed through a different Chebyshev curve each bar, so the tune leaps up the harmonic series, over a bass folded onto itself until it tears and drums run through a rectifier.

sketches.name: Fractal Panic
sketches.description: A melody grown for seven generations of rewriting, in phrygian dominant, over kicks and snares from residue-class sieves, Thue-Morse hats, toms on the primes and a bass counting Collatz steps through a screaming filter.
sketches.source:
setcpm(140/4)

// Seven generations of rewriting: 0 becomes 0 3, 3 becomes 5 0, 5 becomes 3, spread over four bars
melody: n(lsys("0", "0=0 3, 3=5 0, 5=3", 7, 4)).scale("C:phrygian dominant").transpose(12)
  .s("square").pw(.2).decay(.08).sustain(0).delay(.25).delaytime(3/16).gain(.16)

// Rhythms from number theory, layered until they make no sense
kick: s("bd").struct(sieve("3@0 | 5@1", 16)).shape(.3).gain(.7)
snare: s("sd").struct(sieve("7@3 | 11@6", 16)).gain(.45)
hats: s("hh").struct(ints("thuemorse", 16)).hpf(7000).gain(.25)
toms: s("lt").struct(ints("prime", 16)).speed(ints("ruler", 16).add(1)).gain(.3)

// The bass counts Collatz steps from each step number, folded into seven degrees, and screams about it
bass: n(ints("collatz", 4).mod(7)).scale("C:phrygian dominant").octave(-1)
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(900).lpq(12).lpenv(3).lpdecay(.1).decay(.15).sustain(.3).gain(.35)

sketches.name: Polka Apocalypse
sketches.description: The world's fastest polka at 220 BPM, which rushes to double speed every eighth bar, while an air-raid siren wails and a rumble grows louder as the sky falls.

sketches.name: Tempo Soup
sketches.description: One figure at five speeds at once, aligned so they all crash into the same note every sixteen bars, while two drummers who disagree drift apart and meet again.
sketches.source:
setcpm(100/4)

// One figure at five speeds, shifted so that every copy reaches the start together at bar 16
soup: n("0 3 5 7 10 7 5 3").scale("C:minor pentatonic").transpose(12)
  .converge(16, 1, 7/6, 5/4, 4/3, 3/2)
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(.15).sustain(0).pan(rand).room(.4).gain(.1)

// Two drummers who disagree: one holds still, the other slips a sixteenth further every bar
drummer1: s("bd ~ sd ~ bd bd sd ~, hh*8").pan(.3).gain(.4)
drummer2: s("bd ~ sd ~ bd bd sd ~, hh*8").phase(1/16).pan(.7).gain(.35)

// A crash on the meeting point, every sixteen bars
crash: s("<cr ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~>").room(.6).gain(.4)

bass: note("<c2 eb2 f2 g2>").s("sine").shape(.2).decay(.4).sustain(.4).release(.2).gain(.4)

sketches.name: Bees in Your Skull
sketches.description: Headphones on: three insects circling your head at different speeds and heights, hats hopping between your ears in a seeded random order, and a drone whose interaural phase spins faster and faster, staying just below the rates that trigger a pulse warning. Only the kick stays in the middle.

sketches.name: Spectral Meltdown
sketches.description: One innocent piano phrase and four ways to wreck it, four bars each: played plainly, frozen into a smear, blurred into fog and combed into metal, while the bass is pitch-shifted further each section until it turns into a robot.
sketches.source:
setcpm(80/4)

// One innocent piano phrase
const phrase = n("<[0 2 4 7] [5 4 2 0] [3 5 7 9] [7@2 4 2]>").scale("F:major").transpose(12)
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.6).sustain(.1).release(.6)

// A: plain. B: frozen into a smear. C: blurred into fog. D: combed into metal at 110 Hz
piano: form("A@4 B@4 C@4 D@4", phrase,
  phrase.spectral("freeze").samount(.9),
  phrase.spectral("blur").samount(.8),
  phrase.spectral("comb").scomb(110).samount(.7)).room(.5).gain(.26)

// The bass, shifted up a fourth, then down a fifth, then flattened into a robot
const line = note("<f2 d2 bb1 c2>")
bass: form("A@4 B@4 C@4 D@4", line,
  line.spectral("shift").sshift(5).samount(1),
  line.spectral("shift").sshift(-7).samount(1),
  line.spectral("robot").samount(1))
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(800).attack(.05).sustain(.7).release(.3).gain(.25)

drums: s("bd ~ ~ bd, ~ rim ~ rim").gain(.35)

sketches.name: Talking Toaster
sketches.description: A kitchen at breakfast: a saw bass that talks in syllables, a radio muttering through a bit-crusher, a kettle working up to a whistle, a toaster pop and a robot voice announcing that the toast is ready.
